concept.text: Clinical benefit rate (CBR) Assessed by radiographic disease assessments per RECIST v1.1. CBR = overall response + stable disease \> 6 months. Stable disease is defined as neither sufficient shrinkage to qualify for PR nor sufficient increase to qualify for progressive disease.
